messages:
riley: Tiny but giant shoutout to @morgan and Facilities for rescuing the ancient office fax and retrieving my contract before the client call. You are the real MVPs. :raised_hands:
morgan: lol the fax was dramatic. needed a delicate touch and a paperclip. :paperclip: glad it made the call!
chen: also shoutout for the surprise scones that appeared in the kitchen this morning 60b made my Monday. who left them?
pat: that was facilities. muffins + scones mission: successful. no medal required but i'll accept stickers. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
facilities-bot: Facilities note: "Emergency Office Bakery Drop" executed at 07:58. If you'd like to nominate a colleague for a snack treat, post here.
riley: official thanks thread: thank you @morgan @pat and facilities team. kept the deal moving and fed the office. :sparkles:
morgan: could not have done it without the sacred duct tape and a very small hammer. :hammer:
chen: adding a virtual cookie to the thread: :cookie:
pat: leaving this pinned so facilities get extra love in retro. also voting for a fortnightly pastry rotation. reactions = :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:
all: :thumbsup: :clap: :heart:
